title: Close the lessons loop: surface what a module already learned at proposal, name where a lesson goes when a build fails, and assemble the archived bundle at finalize
description: Close the lessons loop: surface what a module already learned at proposal, name where a lesson goes when a build fails, and assemble the archived bundle at finalize
acceptance_criteria: change new names each affected module context.md with its substantive line count, and stays silent for a module whose context holds only scaffold
a FAILED change check names where the lesson goes; a passing check prints nothing
finalize writes lesson-bundle.md into the archive and next_action names the fold-back targets before the merge
lessons policy lives in src/change.rs and the command layer only renders it
frontmatter stripping has one definition inside the change module, matching view::strip_frontmatter, pinned by a horizontal-rule regression test
